title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Transparency Measures—Lowering the Disclosure Threshold) Bill 2019
short_title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Transparency Measures—Lowering the Disclosure Threshold) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would lower the amount of political donations that must be reported to the Australian Electoral Commission.
It would change the disclosure threshold from a figure that rises with inflation to a fixed $1,000.
The change would start on the first 1 July after the bill becomes law.
changes: Lowers the disclosure threshold for political donations from $13,800 to $1,000.
Removes indexation so the threshold becomes a fixed dollar amount.
Prevents regulations from setting a disclosure amount higher than the threshold.
summary.affected: Political donors, candidates, parties and the Australian Electoral Commission.
